newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Chinese caught trying to sneak into S.Korea.
newsitem.headline: Chinese caught trying to sneak into S.Korea.

text.p: South Korean police on Wednesday picked up 62 mainland Chinese trying to sneak into the country by boat, a police officer said.
He said authorities believed the 62 Chinese were transferred on the high seas from a Chinese boat to a Korean vessel for the final stage of the journey to South Korea."
The transfer occurred 29 miles (46.4 km) southeast of the South Korean Island of Cheju off the southern coast of the Korean peninsula, the officer said by telephone from Cheju.
Maritime police were tipped off by a Korean fishing boat in the area, but the Chinese vessel had vanished by the time a South Korean naval ship arrived at the scene.
The Korean vessel carrying the illegal immigrants is being towed to South Korea by the naval ship.
"We don't know why they were trying to sneak in," said the police officer. "But we'll find out through an investigation."
A large number of Chinese, many of them ethnic Koreans, are working illegally in South Korea.
South Korean authorities are cracking down on Korean middlemen who make large sums of money by importing cheap Chinese labour.
